_doc: Cross-surface delivery registry for the route-to plugin. This file is INSTANCE config — copy it to $NYX_DATA_DIR/route-to/surfaces.json and edit there; do NOT commit a real one to Core. One sink is registered per surface key. Schema per surface: kind (ssh | ssh-local | icloud | telegram), address (ssh-host alias or telegram chat-id; omit for icloud/ssh-local), inbox (destination dir — remote-relative for ssh, local path for ssh-local/icloud), notify (true to also fire a Telegram heads-up after delivery), open_app (optional `open -a` app hint for ssh / ssh-local). Telegram creds come from TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env, never from this file.

mbp.notes: Source host. ssh-local skips the network — copies in place and `open`s.

mba.notes: Remote read surface via ~/.ssh/config Host alias. open_app overrides the default handler.

iphone.notes: Copies into the iCloud Drive dir; sync propagates to signed-in devices.

telegram.notes: Direct doc upload to Telegram. address may pin a literal chat-id; ${VAR} falls back to env.
